The *Bākulattheraapadāna* (Tha-Ap 398) is a verse text preserved in the *Therāpadāna* section of the Pali Tipiṭaka [SuttaCentral]. It presents the narrative of the elder Bākula within the biographical poetic collection of the Apadāna. SuttaCentral notes five translations of the work across five modern languages [SuttaCentral].
Regarding textual parallels and text reuse, SuttaCentral registers a passage-level parallel between this text and the *Buddhaappābādhapañha* of the *Milindapañha* (Mil 5.5.3) [SuttaCentral]. In particular, an extensive sequence of the text (§1.1–31.1) is closely shared with the first volume of the *Theragāthā-aṭṭhakathā* (similarity 0.92) [DharmaNexus]. Smaller blocks of shared formulaic verses are also found in the second volume of the *Theragāthā-aṭṭhakathā*, the *Therīgāthā-aṭṭhakathā*, and various other *Therāpadāna* compositions, including the *Upālittheraapadāna* (Tha-Ap 8), the *Ajitattheraapadāna* (Tha-Ap 402), and the *Sabbadāyakattheraapadāna* (Tha-Ap 401) [DharmaNexus].
